about: Social posts the team added by hand after the catalogue (scripts/page_media.py shows them with the posts of media.json, newest first; scripts/sync_media.py never writes this file). One post per line; added: the day it was added.

posts.text:
We're launching the world’s first-of-its-kind humanitarian insurance safety net.

When disasters strike and demand overwhelms resources, insurers step in with additional funding.

With @UNICEF & @WFP, we’re building financial architecture to protect people before the worst hits.
